<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Configure weekly dependency version-update proposals for the existing Cargo workspace and GitHub Actions, with bounded open PRs and the unchanged pull-request quality workflow. This is source preparation, not GitHub activation or observed bot execution.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Maintain visibility of available Cargo dependency and GitHub Action updates through ordinary reviewable pull requests.
- Keep dependency proposals on the existing read-only pull-request CI path without bot-specific privilege escalation.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No dependency or action-version upgrades in this change; no product-code changes.
- No npm or other speculative ecosystems, reviewers, auto-merge, private registry credentials or new runtime dependencies.
- No commit, push, pull request, merge, visibility change, publication or claim of remote Dependabot activation.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Source inspection: Cargo.toml:1-3 declares the root workspace, with dependency declarations at lines 12-33 and a root Cargo.lock. The assignment confirms no tracked npm package manifest. .github/workflows/rust.yml:3-8 enables push and pull_request with contents: read; lines 10-32 contain no actor, branch or path exclusion and invoke harness boot --json on Ubuntu and macOS. checkout and setup-node remain at v4. GitHub documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/secure-your-supply-chain/secure-your-dependencies/configure-version-updates and https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference .

<a id="risks-assumptions"></a>

## Risks & Assumptions

Dependabot reads configuration from the default branch. A local branch does not activate GitHub schedules or prove a real bot PR/CI run. The open PR limits constrain version-update PRs per ecosystem, not every security-update PR. The GitHub Actions ecosystem updates action references, not the npm install --global harness version embedded in a shell command. Hosted policy, service health and update availability remain external prerequisites.

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

Added and locally validated .github/dependabot.yml for Cargo and GitHub Actions, weekly with version-update PR limits 5/2. Existing read-only Ubuntu/macOS pull_request CI is unchanged. Source-scoped ACs are verified; no hosted bot execution or activation claim. Main preserves the work in the isolated branch; no visibility change or remote publication.
